plan: Given my private value of $30, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while ensuring a competitive bid. Rational bidders aim to bid just above the expected third-highest bid. Assuming uniform distribution and rationality, the expected third-highest bid is around $16. I will bid $20 to balance winning probability and profit, as bidding too close to $30 risks overpayment if I win.

Since this is a single round with no history, I'll bid slightly above half of my value to ensure a potential win while minimizing loss. Bidding half of my value ($14) plus a small increment ($0.1) should outbid conservative rational bidders while maximizing profit if I win.

Given my value of $24, I aim to bid slightly above the expected average bid to maximize profit. Rational bidders will bid below their value to ensure profit if they win. Assuming values are uniformly distributed, the average value is $24.5. A bid around $20 should be competitive, allowing room for profit if I win, as the third-highest bid will likely be lower. This balances risk and potential gain, considering no prior history.
